title: Selah Quartz Timer

controlChangeCommands.name: Tap
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Remote tap — any value simulates onboard foot-tap / BPM. Factory fixed incoming utility CC.

x_pc.additionalInfo: PC 0–99 recalls Quartz presets. Outgoing MIDI Stacks (PC/CC/Note chains per preset) are user-programmed in the editor — not a factory parameter map.

additionalInfo: Selah Effects Quartz Timer (V1–V3; company defunct). Incoming: PC 0–99, CC44 tap, MIDI Clock slave (24 PPQN). Transmits MIDI Clock as master; Thru/merge of real-time. No fixed effect-parameter CC table — stacks are user-defined outbound. V3 TRS polarity via hardware dips for Chase Bliss / Empress / Meris style targets. Distinct from Scarlett Love.
